notes: Primary full paper (Adv. Funct. Mater. 2006). H2 uptake measured volumetrically on an Autosorb-1 at -196 C (1 atm and 0.1 atm; Figs. 5-8) and isotherms to ca. 760 mm Hg (Fig. 7); text gives 'up to 336 cm3 g-1 (3.0 wt %)' (p. 4). I4 rests on figure-reported values only: BET SSA of the paper's CDC samples plotted in Fig. 1 and NLDFT SSA of pores below/above 1 nm in Fig. 5b,d; no SSA number appears in text or a table. Experimental states Ar isotherms were analyzed by BET and NLDFT 'to reveal the SSA and PSDs of CDC'. The paper cites its own earlier report (ref. [14], 'We recently reported[14] the effect of pore size on the H2 sorption'), but does not state that every uptake value was published before, so duplicate_data is not applied. record.json is_retracted false; no retraction statement in the PDF.
